instruction: Product Presentation Board Build a simple chair product and produce a 5-scene presentation board: a hero 3/4 view, a front orthographic view, a side orthographic view, an exploded view (parts pulled apart along the chair's local +Z axis), and a dimensioned view showing the chair's major dimensions. There is no initial file - model the chair from scratch. Chair specification (metres; world origin at centre of chair footprint, floor at Z = 0): - **Seat**: rectangular slab 0.50 x 0.50 x 0.05 m. Top face at Z = 0.45 m (bottom at Z = 0.40 m). Centred on X/Y. - **Backrest**: thin board 0.50 x 0.04 x 0.55 m, placed along the rear edge (-Y side). Bottom at Z = 0.45 m. - **4 Legs**: 0.05 x 0.05 x 0.45 m cuboid prisms at the 4 corners of the seat footprint, rising from Z = 0 to Z = 0.45 m. - **2 Armrests**: horizontal pads 0.05 x 0.50 x 0.03 m on each side (+X and -X), top at Z = 0.68 m (0.20 m above the seat top). Total distinct rigid parts in the assembly: **at least 6** (seat, backrest, 4 legs; armrests count as 2 more = 8). Deliverables (produce all): 1. **`C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.dae`** - the assembled chair. Every part is a separate scene node. 2. **`C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output_exploded.dae`** - an exploded version of the same chair. Each part's local frame is translated **at least 0.30 m along +Z** so the parts visibly pull apart. Different parts should have different explosion offsets so the parts don't overlap: e.g. legs stay at +0.3 m, seat at +0.8 m, armrests at +1.3 m, backrest at +1.8 m. The total Z extent of the exploded assembly must be **at least 1 m greater** than the assembled chair. 3. **`C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes.json`** - a JSON file describing the 5 scenes: { "scenes": [ {"name": "S_Main", "kind": "hero_3_4", "position": [x, y, z], "look_at": [x, y, z], "up": [0, 0, 1], "fov_deg": 45.0}, {"name": "S_Front", "kind": "ortho_front",...}, {"name": "S_Side", "kind": "ortho_side",...}, {"name": "S_Exploded", "kind": "exploded",...}, {"name": "S_Dims", "kind": "dimensioned",...} ] } Scene names must be exactly `S_Main`, `S_Front`, `S_Side`, `S_Exploded`, `S_Dims`. 4. **5 scene-render PNGs** under `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes/`: `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes/S_Main.png`, `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes/S_Front.png`, `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes/S_Side.png`, `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes/S_Exploded.png`, `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes/S_Dims.png`. Each is a simple offline perspective (or orthographic) projection rendered from the corresponding camera - a black silhouette on a white background is acceptable, but every frame must visibly differ from every other frame (different camera -> different silhouette; the exploded view should render the exploded DAE; the dims view can draw dimension lines). Requirements: 1. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.dae` and `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output_exploded.dae` both parse as valid COLLADA and contain at least 6 scene nodes each (seat + backrest + 4 legs + 2 armrests = 8 parts). 2. The exploded DAE has Z extent >= assembled Z extent + 1.0 m (parts visibly pulled apart). 3. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes.json` parses and contains exactly 5 scenes with names `S_Main`, `S_Front`, `S_Side`, `S_Exploded`, `S_Dims`. 4. All 5 PNGs exist under `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes/`, each >= 64x64 px. 5. The 5 PNGs are pairwise distinct - every scene's silhouette centroid or fill-pixel count differs from every other scene's by a clear margin. [Software] Launch SketchUp with `C:\SketchUp 2026 26.0.429 x64 En Portable\SketchUp.exe` (adjust if your install differs).
